description: Objective social claim kit registry. Parameterized by brand handle/email/domain/phone. Any passport builder, dash guide card, MCP client, or agent reads this file — never a per-brand wiki.

defaults.bio_primary: {{display_name}} — odd little gifts for the things they're obsessed with. From $7.99 · {{domain}}
defaults.bio_short: Odd little gifts for the obsessed. From $7.99 · {{domain}}
defaults.bio_x: Personalised hobby + stocking filler gifts from $7.99. Your thing. In brick. {{domain}}
do_not: Use a personal phone or personal email for brand accounts
Auto-publish — publish gates stay human_confirm until QP receipts exist
Invent a fallback handle if the exact one is taken — screenshot + report
Post product links before Wave 1 assets exist
after_claim: Flip bgraph registry branch status ready_to_claim → claimed
Later: one OAuth click per platform (Postiz) — still human_confirm

tiktok.label: TikTok
steps: Sign up with the brand phone OTP (or brand email). Read OTPs at {{otp_app}} → SMS tab
If the UI shows taken: stop, screenshot, report — do not grab a silent variant
Profile photo optional if no clean brand asset yet
Do not post yet — claim + bio + link only
Reply DONE when bio is live
tiktok.first_content_idea: Upload pet/product photo → personalisation reveal, no hard sell

youtube.label: YouTube
steps: Sign in with a Google account you control for the brand (prefer a clean brand Google — do not casually convert a personal channel)
Create a Brand Account named {{display_name}} (not personal)
Banner: solid cream is fine if no brand kit asset
Keep uploads unlisted until human flips public
youtube.first_content_idea: Unlisted Shorts = vertical product reveals when assets exist

x.label: X
steps: Sign up with brand phone OTP + {{email}}
No brand marks in replies — stay warm/odd
x.pin_post: {{display_name}} — odd little gifts for the things they're obsessed with. Stocking fillers from $7.99 → {{website}}
x.first_content_idea: Pin Q4 headline + site; replies stay human

instagram.label: Instagram
steps: Sign up with brand phone OTP or {{email}}
If taken by a stranger: screenshot + report; archive variant only if explicitly decided
First posts only when Wave 1 assets exist

pinterest.label: Pinterest
steps: Create boards named for shelves, not random
Highest intent for Christmas gift search — boards first, pins after assets
pinterest.first_content_idea: Stocking Fillers · Game Night · Personalised Christmas boards

github.label: GitHub
steps: Optional — only if shipping public repos or a profile matters

universal.otp_dependency: Social OTPs depend on brand phone inbound SMS. Prove with a TEST SMS first, then claim. If nothing arrives: Telnyx portal → number → Messaging profile must be attached.
